agenda: MT2 program, stage 0: the thesis-killer -- does soft-slice global routing retain its power when fed exclusively invariant features?
thesis: GT's measured advantages live in normalized global routing, not in raw-coordinate access; MT's contracts can be paid once at the network edges (GLOBE-style input-covariant featurization + vector-basis outputs) at ~zero interior cost.

architecture_v0.name: MeshTransformer2 (physicsnemo/experimental/nn/mt2)
architecture_v0.inputs: interior points (cell centroids), normals, unit drive direction, optional per-point quadrature measure weights
architecture_v0.invariant_featurization: per-point vector set {r_i=(x_i-mean)/L_ref, n_i, d}: |r|, log|r|, rhat.d, rhat.n, n.d (no chirality pseudo-scalar in v0 -- exact O(3))
architecture_v0.backbone: L pre-LN layers of measure-weighted soft-slice attention (S learned slices; assignment softmax; slice states measure-weighted means) + slice-mixing MLP + broadcast, all on invariant channels
architecture_v0.equivariant_head: pressure = MLP(h); wss = sum of invariant coefficients x basis {d, n_i, rhat_i + spherical-basis complements per GLOBE field_kernel}
architecture_v0.contracts: exact similarity equivariance by construction; exact drive degree 1 via output scaling by |d_input|; normalization on every pathway

arms.baselines_frozen: gt_fixed_seed{42,43,44} (10k in-family 0.0530-0.0534; rotation-orbit 26-32x degraded; density-bias 3.6x; VRAM 4.6GB; wall 3.6h)

protocol: frozen 2026-08 protocol verbatim; paired instrument (in-family 5-res sweep, estate+fastback smoke) plus P1 rotation probe and P3v2/v3 density probes

deciding_gates.S0_1_thesis: in-family 10k seed-mean <= 1.30x GT's (0.0532): thesis survives; <= 1.10x: strong pass; > 1.50x: thesis REFUTED (invariant features break slice routing) and MT2 redesigns around frame-averaged raw coordinates
deciding_gates.S0_2_contract: P1 rotation ratio <= 1.05 on all seeds (exact equivariance verified end-to-end; anything else is an implementation bug, not a result)
deciding_gates.S0_3_resources: peak VRAM <= 1.5x GT (<= 7 GB) and wall <= 1.5x GT (<= 5.5 h)
deciding_gates.S0_4_density: P3v2-instrument ratio reported vs GT's 1.9-3.6x and MT's 1.7-2.5x (measure-weighted softmax should sit at or below MT's mitigation level)
deciding_gates.S0_5_zero_shot: estate+fastback smoke descriptive; GT-like local features + routing make skill (< 0.8) plausible (p ~ 0.4)

predictions.S0_2: passes after at most one bug-fix iteration (p ~ 0.8); unit equivariance test gates launch

falsifier: S0_1 > 1.50x with S0_2 passing kills the central MT2 bet as formulated; the recorded fallback is frame-averaging over input-derived frames on raw coordinates, which trades exactness cost for representation freedom.
